goal: Ensure transaction lookups report disk and index read errors instead of falsely reporting missing transactions
Help node operators and RPC callers detect underlying storage corruption and pruned block states quickly
agreement: Strong support for separating actual missing transactions from I/O or index read failures
Support because confirmed transactions should not be reported as missing on error (ryanofsky)
Objection resolved: pruned block queries report unavailable data instead of I/O errors (yuvicc)
Addressed concerns on skipping unclean shutdown entries and handling pruning races (ryanofsky)

categories.name: indexes
why: P2 because it stops index read failures and corruption from silently pretending a transaction is missing.
Alerts operators to database corruption instead of returning misleading empty results.

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because RPC callers receive actionable I/O and corruption errors instead of false not-found messages.
Prevents callers from misinterpreting pruned block data or disk failures as nonexistent transactions.
